2610.12341.title: Can AI Agents Learn Their Way to the Top? Evaluating Heuristic Learning in a Long-Running Game Agent Competition
2610.12341.paper_summary: Adversarial games have driven advances from heuristic search to reinforcement learning, yet learning and adapting strategies from limited samples remain challenging. AI agents offer an alternative by turning game experience into revisions of executable policies. Building on heuristic learning (HL), we formalize Adversarial Heuristic Learning (AHL), a paradigm that uses AI agents as learning engines to refine game policies and supporting software while keeping model weights fixed. We introduce AAArena, a benchmark comprising 12 authentic adversarial games and 1,920 archived human programs, with an evaluation protocol modeled on real-world game competitions. Agents interpret rules, choose opponents, analyze replays, and revise game agents to achieve their highest ranking within fixed match and evaluation budgets. We evaluate \val{completedmodels} model and harness configurations: Opus5.5 with Claude Code earns 6 gold medals, while no evaluated configuration tops the remaining 6 human ladders. Performance is generally weaker in games with more complex rule specifications. Further experiments show that opponent selection and dense feedback support policy improvement, and that agents learn from both on-policy replays of their own matches and off-policy replays of other players' matches. These results highlight HL's potential in adversarial games and identify persistent challenges in game understanding, strategy implementation, and long-horizon policy development.
2610.12341.paper_summary_zh: 對抗性遊戲推動了從啟發式搜索到強化學習的進步，但從有限樣本中學習和調整策略仍然具有挑戰性。AI代理提供了一種替代方案，將遊戲經驗轉化為可執行政策的修訂。基於啟發式學習（HL），我們正式定義對抗性啟發式學習（AHL），這是一種使用AI代理作為學習引擎來精煉遊戲政策和支持軟體的範式，同時保持模型權重不變。我們推出了AAArena，一個基準，包括12個真實的對抗性遊戲和1,920個存檔的人類程序，評估協議模擬了現實世界的遊戲競賽。代理解釋規則、選擇對手、分析重播並修訂遊戲代理，以在固定的比賽和評估預算內達到最高排名。我們評估了\val{completedmodels}模型和配置：Opus5.5與Claude Code獲得6枚金牌，而沒有評估的配置超過剩餘的6個人類梯子。在規則規範更複雜的遊戲中，表現通常較弱。進一步的實驗顯示，對手選擇和密集反饋支持政策改進，並且代理從自己比賽的在政策重播和其他玩家比賽的非政策重播中學習。這些結果突顯了HL在對抗性遊戲中的潛力，並確定了遊戲理解、策略實施和長期政策開發中的持續挑戰。
